Renaissance Firearms.name: Fine Dueling Pistol

Modern Firearms.name: Quickdraw Pistol

Magic.name: Gravity Hammer
Magic.special: Heavy, two-handed, energy, concussive (targets within 10 feet must make a Strength save or be knocked prone)

Magic.name: Quantum Dagger
Magic.special: Thrown (range 20/60), returns to wielder's hand after being thrown, energy, deals additional 1d6 force damage

Magic.name: Phasebow
Magic.special: Ammunition (range 150/600), two-handed, magic. This bow's arrows can harmlessly pass through solid objects and barriers of nearly any mundane material; if the attacker knows the target's exact position, they can target a creature on the far side of such cover. When an attack from this bow passes through an object or barrier before striking a target, it deals an additional 1d4 force damage. Some extremely robust or exotic magical materials may block this effect at the DM's discretion.

Magic.name: Photonic Phasebow
Magic.special: Ammunition (range 150/600), two-handed, energy. When fired without special ammunition, this bow's photonic bolts behave like a Phasebow's shots: they can pass harmlessly through solid objects to strike a target the wielder can precisely locate, and if they pass through cover before hitting a foe the attack deals an extra 1d4 force damage. When using psicrystal bolts worth 5 gp each as ammunition, the base damage increases to 2d10 radiant and the bonus force damage on a shot that passes through cover increases to 1d10.

Futuristic Firearms.name: Lighter Pistol
Futuristic Firearms.special: (range 40/120), energy, reload (12); a sleek finesse sidearm. Its detachable barrel (included with the weapon) can be removed to hide the pistol as a holdout weapon, but while the barrel is off its range becomes 20/60 and attack rolls suffer a -1 penalty.

Futuristic Firearms.name: Phase-Crossbow
Futuristic Firearms.special: Ammunition (range 120/480), reload (3), two-handed, energy. This crossbow is designed to fire psicrystal bolts that cost 1 gp each. It can chamber up to three such bolts at a time. Its bolts may be loosed through solid obstacles toward a creature whose precise position the wielder knows; when a shot passes through cover in this way, it gains the usual bonus force damage granted by phase-weapon effects (such as Phasic Ammunition or a Phasebow).

Futuristic Firearms.name: Phase-Crossballista
Futuristic Firearms.special: Siege, heavy, two-handed, energy. While you are braced to fire this weapon, your speed is reduced to 15 feet. Without special ammunition it fires a single radiant bolt (range 200/800) that behaves as a phase shot, able to pass through solid cover to strike a creature whose location you know; if it passes through cover before hitting, it also deals the usual bonus force damage for a phase weapon. As an alternate fire mode, it can expend a psicrystal bolt-canister worth 10 gp as ammunition to fire an explosive canister shot. On a hit, the canister detonates even if it does not directly strike a creature, creating a blast: all enemies within 5 feet of the target point (10 feet if the attack roll was made with advantage) must make a Dexterity saving throw contested against the attack roll. On a failure they take 3d12 radiant damage; on a success they take half. If a creature of CR 4 or lower is critically hit by the canister shot, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be instantly slain by the blast; even on a success, it still suffers the critical hit damage as normal.

Futuristic Firearms.name: Freeze Rifle
Futuristic Firearms.special: (range 100/300), energy, reload (10), two-handed, on a hit the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or have its speed halved until the start of your next turn

Futuristic Firearms.name: Radiant Automatic Rifle
Futuristic Firearms.special: (range 80/240), energy, reload (30), two-handed, burst fire; when you take the Attack action with this weapon you can split the damage of a single attack between up to two creatures within 10 feet of each other that are both within range and line of sight

Futuristic Firearms.name: Gunblade
Futuristic Firearms.special: Hybrid melee firearm (range 30/90), ammunition, reload (6). On an attack roll of 18 or higher, the shot detonates on impact and the target takes an additional 1d10 radiant damage.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Extra Padding Layer
regaliaUpgrades.description: Adds an additional layer of reinforced impact-absorbing material. Grants **+3 to the Regalia's base AC** and **resistance to all non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Reinforced Seams
regaliaUpgrades.description: Fortified stitching prevents tears and grants **immunity to forced movement effects** (shoves, grapples, knockbacks). Additionally, once per long rest, wearer can **convert any critical fumble into a normal roll**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Superior Leak-Guard Technology
regaliaUpgrades.description: Advanced absorbent cores ensure **absolute containment**. Wearer gains **immunity to all contamination effects** (poison, disease, curses that spread by touch or proximity). Additionally, minor mess-based hazards automatically fail against the wearer.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Impact Dampening Gel Inserts
regaliaUpgrades.description: Strategically placed gel packs absorb kinetic energy. Wearer gains **resistance to force and thunder damage**. Additionally, any single incoming hit **over 30 damage** is automatically reduced by **half** once per short rest.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Anti-Monster-Under-The-Bed Weave
regaliaUpgrades.description: Enchanted fabric wards off childhood fears. Wearer gains **immunity to fear effects**. Once per long rest, they may **force an ally within 30 feet to ignore a fear effect**, even if they've already failed a saving throw.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Changing Grace
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per short rest, the wearer may instantly change their diaper with one in their inventory as a bonus action. This can also be used as a reaction when the wearer's diaper is rendered soiled or affected by magical status. Cannot be used to remove a cursed diaper of higher level than the wearer.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Quick-Release Fasteners
regaliaUpgrades.description: Oversized snaps allow rapid changes. Wearer may **don or doff this regalia as a bonus action** and **gain advantage on checks to escape grapples and restraints**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Emergency Snack Pouch
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, consuming a snack from this pouch grants the wearer **temporary HP equal to twice their level** and **removes one level of exhaustion**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Odor-Neutralizing Charcoal Weave
regaliaUpgrades.description: Fabric neutralizes odors entirely. Wearer gains **immunity to scent-based detection** (tracking, divination effects relying on smell). Additionally, they gain **advantage on all social skill checks (Persuasion, Deception, Intimidation) for 1 hour after using this feature**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Comfort-Luxe Lining
regaliaUpgrades.description: Ultra-soft lining enhances endurance. Wearer **has advantage on all Constitution saves against exhaustion** and recovers **an additional hit dice** during short rests. Additionally, poor conditions or lack of a bedroll do not prevent the wearer from gaining the benefits of a long rest.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Reflective Safety Patches
regaliaUpgrades.description: Shiny patches increase visibility. Wearer **cannot be surprised** while awake and imposes **disadvantage** on attacks against them in dim light or darkness.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Feather-Light Weave
regaliaUpgrades.description: Advanced tailoring removes burdens. Wearer **ignores movement restrictions from all armor and heavy clothing** and **gains +10 feet to movement speed**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Instant Wardrobe Switch
regaliaUpgrades.description: Magically enhances swift changes. Wearer may **swap regalia as a free action**, and their **previous armor bonus continues for one additional round**, even after switching to another outfit.

regaliaUpgrades.name: 'Oopsie Absorption' Field
regaliaUpgrades.description: Regalia **automatically negates any accidental contamination** (mess, poison, hazardous splash effects). Additionally, when negating an effect, the wearer **gains advantage on their next saving throw, attack, or skill check**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Cushioned Landing System
regaliaUpgrades.description: Regalia **completely negates all fall damage** for the wearer and provides **resistance to forced knockdowns and prone conditions**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: 'Quiet Time' Aura Emitter
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, wearer emits a **10ft aura** that forces all creatures within range to **make a DC 18 Wisdom save** or become **unable to take aggressive actions for 1 minute**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Waddle-Dash Maneuver
regaliaUpgrades.description: Wearer performs a **supernaturally fast waddle-dash** as a **bonus action**, increasing movement speed by **30 feet for one turn**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: 'Look At Me!' Distraction Charm
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per encounter, as a **reaction**, the regalia flashes with dazzling patterns, imposing **disadvantage on ALL attacks against the wearer for one full round**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Prefect's Badge of Authority
regaliaUpgrades.description: An embroidered badge signifying status. Grants **+4 bonus** to Intimidation and Persuasion checks when interacting with lower-ranking individuals.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Secret Stash Pockets
regaliaUpgrades.description: Extra hidden compartments allow concealed storage. Wearer gains **advantage on all Sleight of Hand checks** and may hide items within their regalia that **cannot be detected by mundane searches**.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Naptime Resilience Protocol
regaliaUpgrades.description: Wearer gains **complete immunity to sleep effects** (magical or non-magical). Additionally, if stunned, they may **make an immediate saving throw with advantage** as a reaction.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Quick-React Reflexes
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as a reaction, the wearer gains a +3 bonus to initiative and advantage on all Dexterity saving throws until the start of their next turn.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Flawless Footwork
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per short rest, the wearer becomes immune to being knocked prone for 1 round and gains advantage on Acrobatics checks while moving.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Minor Fortification
regaliaUpgrades.description: As a reaction (once per short rest), the wearer gains a +3 bonus to AC against a single attack, potentially causing it to miss.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Swift Recovery Glyph
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per short rest, when reduced below half their maximum HP, the wearer regains hit points equal to 1d6 + their level as an immediate burst of rejuvenation.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Reactive Ward
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, when hit by an attack, the wearer can use their reaction to reduce the damage from that attack by an amount equal to their proficiency bonus × 2.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Enhanced Barrier Weave
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, for 10 rounds the wearer gains a +2 bonus to AC and resistance to one damage type of their choice (physical or magical) for the duration of the effect.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Mystic Reversal
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per short rest, when targeted by a spell, the wearer may force the caster to make a spellcasting ability check against the wearer's spell save DC. On a failure, the spell is reflected back at the caster.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Empowered Concentration
regaliaUpgrades.description: When activated (once per long rest), for 1 minute the wearer has advantage on concentration checks and adds a +2 bonus to all saving throws against spells.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Titanic Core
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest for 1 minute, the wearer's maximum HP increases by 20 and they gain regeneration, recovering 3 hit points at the start of each of their turns.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Guardian's Accord
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the wearer can redirect the attack to themselves, taking the damage instead but with resistance to it.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Colossus Shield Matrix
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, the wearer activates this upgrade to gain immunity to all non-magical physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing) for 1 minute.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Arcane Barrier Nexus
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as an action, the wearer activates the nexus to gain resistance to all magical damage and advantage on saving throws against spells for 1 minute.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Absolute Ward
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as an action, the wearer creates a protective field that grants themselves and all allies within 10 feet immunity to all damage for 1 round.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Legendary Resilience
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, the wearer gains immunity to all conditions (charmed, frightened, stunned, etc.) for 1 minute and can end one condition affecting them as a bonus action.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Vortex of Defiance
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as a reaction when taking damage, the wearer converts up to 30 points of that damage into healing for themselves and allies within 15 feet, split evenly among all targets.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Omni-Defender Regalia
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per short rest, as an action, the wearer may choose to gain complete immunity to either physical or magical damage for 1 minute. During this time, all damage of the chosen type is completely negated.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Aegis of the Gods
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as an action, the wearer activates this upgrade to become immune to both physical and magical damage simultaneously for 1 round, then gains resistance to all damage for 1 minute afterward.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Divine Bastion
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as an action, the wearer creates an impenetrable barrier around themselves and allies within 15 feet that grants immunity to all damage and harmful effects for 1 round, then grants 30 temporary hit points to each protected creature.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Celestial Ward of Perpetuity
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, the wearer may choose two damage types and gain immunity to them for 1 minute. Additionally, any healing the wearer receives during this time is increased by 50%.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Absolute Omni-Shield
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, for 1 minute the wearer gains immunity to the next instance of each damage type they would take, effectively negating one hit of each damage type in the game.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Ascendant Regalia of Eternal Light
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as an action, the wearer activates this 5-slot upgrade to become completely immune to all damage and conditions for 1 minute. In addition, allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to twice the wearer's level at the start of each of their turns and advantage on all saving throws.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Diaper of Ultimate Cleanliness
regaliaUpgrades.description: Once per long rest, as an action, the wearer activates this 5-slot upgrade. For 1 minute, they gain immunity to all damage and conditions. Additionally, at the start of each of the wearer's turns, all enemies within 30 feet must make a DC 17 Wisdom save or be charmed until the start of their next turn, finding the wearer simply too adorable to attack.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Crawling Speed Enhancement
regaliaUpgrades.description: Specially reinforced knees and elbows. Your **crawling movement doesn't count as difficult terrain**, and you can crawl at **half your walking speed** instead of one-third. Additionally, you have **advantage on Stealth checks** while crawling.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Emergency Phase Shift
regaliaUpgrades.description: Distortion field creates momentary safety. Once per short rest, as a reaction when targeted by an attack, you can **teleport up to 30 feet** to an unoccupied space you can see, completely avoiding the attack.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Tactical Opportunity Matrix
regaliaUpgrades.description: Combat analysis systems enhance reactions. Once per combat, you can **take an additional reaction** during a round. Additionally, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Harmonic Resonance Shield
regaliaUpgrades.description: Vibrating defensive field. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, create a **10-foot radius aura** around yourself that grants allies within it **resistance to thunder and force damage** for 1 minute.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Sudden Growth Spurt
regaliaUpgrades.description: Magical regalia temporarily enhances size. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can **increase your size category by one** for 1 minute, gaining all benefits of the Enlarge spell without concentration.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Playful Illusion Projector
regaliaUpgrades.description: Creates distracting images of toys and childish things. Once per short rest, as an action, you can cast **Mirror Image** on yourself without requiring components or concentration.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Timeout Corner Protocol
regaliaUpgrades.description: Creates a disciplinary zone. Once per long rest, as an action, you create a **5-foot cube force field** within 30 feet. A creature inside must make a DC 15 Wisdom save or be unable to leave the zone for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Scholar's Perfect Recall
regaliaUpgrades.description: Academic enhancement systems. Once per long rest, you can recall any information you've ever learned with perfect clarity, gaining advantage and double proficiency bonus on any Intelligence-based check for 10 minutes.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Faculty Override Authorization
regaliaUpgrades.description: Special insignia of authority. You gain **advantage on Persuasion checks** when dealing with institutional authorities. Additionally, once per long rest, you can cast **Command** as a 2nd-level spell without components.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Research Assistant Protocol
regaliaUpgrades.description: Enchantment aids in locating information. When searching for specific information in a library or archive, you locate it in half the normal time. You also gain a **+5 bonus to Investigation checks** when examining written materials.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Gold Star Achievement System
regaliaUpgrades.description: Magical rewards for good behavior. Whenever you roll a natural 20 on an ability check, save, or attack roll, you gain a "gold star" that you can spend to gain advantage on any single roll. You can store up to 3 gold stars at once.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Nap Mat Deployment
regaliaUpgrades.description: Emergency rest capabilities. Once per long rest, as an action, you can create a comfortable resting space that allows you to gain the benefits of a short rest in just 10 minutes instead of 1 hour.

regaliaUpgrades.name: Recess Energy Reserves
regaliaUpgrades.description: Stored playful energy enhances performance. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can expend one hit die to gain **advantage on all Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks** for 1 minute.
